description: One incident, whole: its alerts (rule, host, labels, annotations, value, who reports it and when it last did, evidence links and commands), who acknowledged, silenced and parked it, how it ended if it ended (a source, or someone by hand, and any confirmation), its history of acknowledgements, silences, reopens and resolves with who did each, every comment, and the pager's last sends. Works for a firing incident and for one that resolved in the last 30 days. Raw payloads are left out.

key.description: The incident key exactly as watch_state or list_incidents print it ("<service>|<rule>", or "<service>|<rule>|<instance>" for a rule split per instance). Not an alert key.

name: get_incident
title: One incident
